summary: Account is brand new (<100 followers total). Lead gen outperforms other services 2.46x. Reels lose 77% viewers in 3s — hooks fail. Instagram bio violates brand rules (niche, region, timeframe, free offer). Bluesky and LinkedIn have near-zero engagement. Top3 hook overused recently.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: try **contrast** or **question** next; pause **top3** (used 4 of last 6 posts).
- Focus on **lead_gen** service — it earns 2.46x median per reach.
- First 3 seconds must stop scroll: open with a sharp pain point, no preamble.
- Speak to **freelancers, agencies, anyone selling a service** — never to one profession.
- Describe the sheet only in general terms: local businesses from Google Places with contact details, review counts, website checks, including newly opened ones.
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work, never like an ad.
- Use only broad hashtags: #FreelanceIndia #Freelancers #LeadGeneration #GetClients #SmallBusinessIndia.

instructions.research: List 5 common lead-gen pain points Indian freelancers/agencies mention in public posts (e.g. 'hours on Google Maps', 'outdated contacts', 'no website flag').
instructions.analysis: Compare the two lead_gen posts' reach/engagement vs the median; note which hook style each used.
instructions.writer: Write a lead_gen post using a **contrast** hook. Open with 'Freelancers' or 'Agencies'. Describe the sheet in general terms. End with 'pay after approval' + DM for honest fit check. No niche, no region, no demo offer.
instructions.image: Create a clean, text-light graphic: a simple spreadsheet silhouette with column headers (Business, Phone, Reviews, Website?) — no real data, no logos.
instructions.video: Skip video today; static image post fits the hook and avoids the 3-second reel drop-off.

manual_tips: Rewrite Instagram bio to: 'Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & lead sheets for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.' (removes niche, region, timeframe, free offer).
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition — add value, don't pitch.
Check LinkedIn notifications; reply to any connection requests or comments from the past week.
